verdict.rationale: Kling documents native speech co-generation, text-to-video with voice control, and an Elements system that keeps a character's identity and voice consistent across shots. Together these imply a user could prompt a custom character to speak scripted lines without a camera or studio. The product is positioned as a general text/image-to-video generator, though, not a script-to-presenter avatar tool. missing for 10: a stock avatar library, a documented paste-a-script-to-presenter workflow, explicit lip-synced script delivery for long-form presenter videos, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
